records.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Chancen und Risiken gentechnischer Anwendungen diskutieren.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss the opportunities and risks of genetic engineering applications.
records.descriptionReason: Clear concise bilingual discussion/justification competence; the detailed mandatory assessment and transfer demand belongs in the existing current v2 profile. No independent assessable routines are bundled in the short goal.
records.DEENParity: Equivalent goal descriptions, all four expectation pairs, both complete case contracts, model responses, mandatory criteria and transfer contracts inspected.
records.scope: Current whole goal, current operative native whole page and supplied materials only; source/course union is separately limited.
records.understanding: Genetic modification, biological property and practical use must be connected while distinguishing contained production from environmental release.
records.performance: Learner develops evidence-bound benefit and risk arguments, compares a real alternative, addresses a counterargument and gives a conditional conclusion.
records.transfer: Field case changes compatible neighbours, pest prevalence and alternative yield. Production case changes containment to direct environmental use, so existing batch/waste evidence cannot license field safety.
caseAssessment: application-field-crop: the joint change of genetic constitution and spraying is explicitly identified; 40/38/39 means without variability do not establish harm or safety. Crop rotation is a meaningful competing intervention.

application-contained-protein: purified protein is distinguished from production cells; 8/10 versus 6/10 and 20 negative waste samples are bounded by sampling and operating conditions. Open release is a substantive exposure change.
records.visual: Balanced panels and the central evidence question support discussion. Drought, yield and biodiversity are examples, not measured effects; this qualification is explicit in the current alt text.

records.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Positionen zu Gentechnikfällen begründen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can justify positions on genetic engineering cases.
records.descriptionReason: Clear concise bilingual discussion/justification competence; the detailed mandatory assessment and transfer demand belongs in the existing current v2 profile. No independent assessable routines are bundled in the short goal.
records.DEENParity: Equivalent goal descriptions, all four expectation pairs, both complete case contracts, model responses, mandatory criteria and transfer contracts inspected.
records.scope: Current whole goal, current operative native whole page and supplied materials only; source/course union is separately limited.
records.understanding: Ethical justification connects biological facts and uncertainty with explicit normative criteria, affected parties and competing action options.
records.performance: Learner distinguishes descriptive from normative claims, explains a values conflict and weighting, justifies an action and handles a substantive opposing argument.
records.transfer: Access conditions change independently of environmental evidence; the somatic study changes to a heritable embryo intervention with new affected people and consent limits.
caseAssessment: ethics-seed-access: funding, access and release can be decided separately; the worked answer does not collapse unresolved environmental evidence into access fairness. Alternative positions remain admissible under all mandatory criteria.

ethics-voluntary-somatic-study: 6 improvements and 2 serious events are observations without causal attribution; urgency is treated substantively, current care and the option to decline remain real, and the task is study design rather than a treatment recommendation.
records.visual: Benefit, fairness and responsibility are parallel viewpoints in a discussion. The chart is an unlabeled benefit symbol, not trial evidence; no viewpoint is declared the winner.

records.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Chancen und Risiken moderner Gentechnik diskutieren.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss the opportunities and risks of modern genetic engineering.
records.descriptionReason: Clear concise bilingual discussion/justification competence; the detailed mandatory assessment and transfer demand belongs in the existing current v2 profile. No independent assessable routines are bundled in the short goal.
records.DEENParity: Equivalent goal descriptions, all four expectation pairs, both complete case contracts, model responses, mandatory criteria and transfer contracts inspected.
records.scope: Current whole goal, current operative native whole page and supplied materials only; source/course union is separately limited.
records.understanding: Target editing, functional evidence and practical benefit are different claims; risks can involve unintended changes or consequences of the intended property under specific inheritance/exposure conditions.
records.performance: Learner uses given biological causal routes, bounds detection, compares an alternative, answers a safety claim and justifies conditions for a recommendation.
records.transfer: Somatic findings do not establish germline/intergenerational safety. The crop case changes pathogen prevalence and the compatible-relative pollen route while preserving molecular findings.
caseAssessment: modern-cell-editing: 45 target edits, 40 function observations and 3 additional changes are not equated; eight locations are not a whole-genome safety test. Protein supplementation is an actual alternative; human benefit remains untested.

modern-edited-crop: disease symptom counts and a possible growth disadvantage are separated from causal attribution. Lack of foreign DNA and negative checks at seven locations do not exclude intended-property effects or pollen dispersal.
records.visual: The straight ladder and its magnification preserve two continuous rails and connected rungs; it is a simplified genetic symbol with no sequence or Cas mechanism asserted. Benefit and risk question marks preserve uncertainty.

sourceJudgment.boundedArgumentProducts: KEEP as concrete partial argumentation opportunities under supplied context, independently generated response and fresh transfer. They do more than explain CRISPR.
sourceJudgment.f53Role: Theory/function/application contribution only; its current description does not require arguing opportunities and risks. Retain its contribution without counting it as argument-operator performance. This label is not compiler projectionRole prerequisiteOnly.
sourceJudgment.partialMapping: KEEP only with partial status and separate theory role. Three genetics products are no complete biotechnological source union, no whole TF11/curriculum approval. Recherche, presentation and technologies explanation/judgment remain distinct page duties.
sourceJudgment.RPStageLimit: Source explicitly prioritizes basic understanding/overview without deeper molecular detail. Supplied CRISPR/production context supports discussion; do not convert the LK theoretical route into a universal SekI detail requirement.
sourceJudgment.HESourceLimit: Actual primary printed38 binds Q1 topics1-3, while Q1.4 is not in that compulsory list. Printed39 gives Q1.4 basic PID/ethics and LK CRISPR/chances-risks. Current canonical formulations are operationalisations, not verbatim official competency bullets. Preserve optionality and the actual HE GK/LK distinction. No new approval of the pre-existing Q1.2 general-application GK placement is inferred.
sourceJudgment.effectiveMembership: All three are operative RP SekI G8/G9 targets. HE SekII GK targets 954 and 5ee; HE SekII LK targets all three. They are absent from BY targets despite raw BY applicability. Page applicability matches this distinction.
